rule: Escalation asks for DesiredWeaponDataType 4 (SurvivalData) [RE MP_ESCALATION_RE.md section 1]. GetWeaponDataByType(4) returns SurvivalData with no fallback inside; TnWeapon.GivenTo falls back for a player pawn to type 1 = PlayerData (the campaign tuning, NOT MultiplayerData); AI holders always use AiData [RE section 7.4, CONFIRMED]. escalation_player_data / escalation_ai_data apply that rule per class. diff = SurvivalData vs PlayerData, tagged properties only (a field the SV object leaves unset inherits from its archetype, so it appears as a difference with survival = null).
